migrationNote: MOVING 100% FROM SOLANA TO ARC. The Arc chain is the source of truth for every feature (lives, points, tiers, competitions, match settlement). The frontend only displays what the chain holds. The one old Solana write left in the game page (dice) is tracked below and must be retired before Solana can be silenced.

chainAudit.runtime Solana left on the Arc path: The Ludo page still loads the Solana SDK (src/main-lab.js configures the MagicBlock ER VRF dice). That is the ONLY Solana write left. On Arc the dice must come from the committed Arc seed via the relayer (the contract already supports it); the page-call fix is item (2x) and it is what item (12) Silence Solana waits on.
chainAudit.Solana is NOT used for: lives, local points, global points, tier/premium, match start commit, match settlement, match history, batch window. Those are all Arc (via /api/arc).
